item.create_originium_industry.originium: Wear on the head to cut dust exposure
Wear on the chest; pairs with the respirator
Alloy-sealed chest filter; extra protection and durability
Create-style _dust mask_. Wear it to slow originium _exposure_.
Spare _filter media_ on the chest. Broken canisters drop _originium dust_.
Alloy _housing_ around a filter canister. Lasts longer and seals residual exposure.
Pollution-resistant _casing_. Place beside machines to cut process dust.
Alloy _filter upgrade_. Attach to a Basin or insert into the kinetic filter.
Dense _reactor shell_. Place beside the power core — tagged `reactor_housing`.
Snow-golem _super chamber_. Attach to a power core for much stronger cooling.
Late-game _kinetic generator_. Needs housing, coolant, and a cooling chamber. Meltdown dumps dust and leaks _purest molten_ — no explosion.

advancements.create_originium_industry.r: Tame a dangerous industrial ore in a mechanical factory.
advancements.create_originium_industry.o: Obtain raw originium. Processing it will kick up dust.
advancements.create_originium_industry.d: Stand in originium fog. Filters and masks come next.
A spinning filter or process sieve captured dust into originium dust.
advancements.create_originium_industry.s: Start an originium power core. Housing, coolant, and a cooling chamber keep it alive.
advancements.create_originium_industry.o: Obtain originium protection gear. A respirator and canister cut exposure.
Obtain an originium alloy ingot. Casings, sieves, and sealed canisters start here.
advancements.create_originium_industry.i: Reach the first infection stage. Short-term exposure became a long-term course.
advancements.create_originium_industry.p: A power core melted down. Dust dumps and molten leaks — it never explodes.
create_originium_industry.ponder.tag.ori: Dust, filters, the purest line, and the power core.
create_originium_industry.ponder.dust_ge: Milling, crushing, or mixing originium emits originium dust into the chunk.
Dust diffuses into neighbouring chunks and decays slowly. A dust meter reads the concentration.
Wear a respirator and filter canister. Accidents dump more dust — they never explode.
create_originium_industry.ponder.dust_fi: Insert a dust sieve into the kinetic filter. Rotation absorbs chunk dust and returns originium dust items.
A process sieve on a Basin, mill, or mixer captures neighbouring emission instead of letting it pollute.
The alloy sieve is a stronger upgrade. A fan nozzle redirects dust downwind. Neither voids dust.
create_originium_industry.ponder.purest_: A Basin sieve filters molten originium into filtered molten originium.
Heat the filtered fluid with culture solution (培养液). The registry id stays originium_catalyst.
Attach a cooling chamber and mix packed ice with no blaze heat to supercool into purest originium.
Superheating is the accident path: purest molten. Meltdown dumps dust and leaks that fluid — it never explodes.
create_originium_industry.ponder.power_c: Place reactor housing beside the power core. Right-click purest originium to fuel it. There is no GUI.
Stability is S = C × M − H. Coolant raises C; cooling chambers raise M; fuel raises H.
When S is at least zero, fluids convert toward coolant. When S is negative, they convert to hot water and dust leaks.
Meltdown dumps a dust burst and leaks remaining fuel as purest molten. It does not explode or spawn TNT.
jei.create_originium_industry.basin_proc: Requires a process sieve on the Basin
jei.create_originium_industry.dust_emiss: Emits %s originium dust into the chunk
jei.create_originium_industry.reactor.fu: Right-click purest originium into the power core. Each item burns for %s ticks. No GUI.
jei.create_originium_industry.reactor.co: S = C × M − H. When S ≥ 0, fluids convert toward coolant; when S < 0 they become hot water.
jei.create_originium_industry.reactor.st: Adjacent reactor housing is required to run. Cooling chambers raise M. Meltdown dumps dust and leaks purest molten — it does not explode.
jei.create_originium_industry.info.power: Late-game kinetic generator. Needs adjacent reactor housing, coolant, and a cooling chamber. Right-click purest originium to fuel it. Meltdown dumps dust and leaks purest molten — never an explosion.
jei.create_originium_industry.info.pures: Power-core fuel. Made on the purest line: sieve-filter molten originium, culture it with 培养液, then supercool with a cooling chamber and no blaze heat.
jei.create_originium_industry.info.origi: Reactor heat-capacity fluid (C). Mix water, 培养液 (originium catalyst), and packed ice. Converts toward water and hot water when the core is unstable.
jei.create_originium_industry.info.dust_: Basin attachment that unlocks filtered-molten mixing and captures neighbouring process emission as originium dust.
jei.create_originium_industry.info.origi: Chunk pollution byproduct. Milling, crushing, and mixing originium emit dust. Kinetic filters and process sieves capture it back into this item.
